title: PawflashPenumbraDAManifest
description: Hosted Download Agent (DA) and Auth file catalog with retail device mappings for MediaTek devices.

version.description: Semantic version or date code of the manifest release.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the last manifest update.

dais.description: List of available DA target entries.

filename.description: Recommended filename when saved to disk.

url.description: Direct HTTP(S) download URL for the binary payload.

sha256.description: Hex-encoded SHA-256 digest of the uncompressed file.

size_bytes.description: Expected byte length for progress estimation and integrity checks.

id.description: Unique slug identifier for the DA entry.

brand.description: OEM / Manufacturer brand name for categorisation and filtering.

devices.description: Marketing and retail model names compatible with this DA.

da.description: The Download Agent binary (.bin) blob metadata.

auth.description: Optional companion SLA / DAA auth file required for secure bootroms.

verified.description: Whether this DA combo has been verified by the community.

notes.description: Optional instructions or test point advice.
